scenario: 公交清分数仓 · 字段口径调整影响分析样例（换乘标志 / 卡状态）

models.name: dwd_card_transaction_detail
models.description: 刷卡交易明细宽表：CTE 清洗卡信息与交易，关联线路维度，并按换乘标志筛选
models.sql: WITH valid_card AS (SELECT ci.card_id AS card_id, ci.card_type AS card_type, ci.issue_city AS issue_city FROM ods_card_info ci WHERE ci.status = 'ACTIVE'), priced AS (SELECT t.transaction_id AS transaction_id, t.card_id AS card_id, t.line_id AS line_id, t.vehicle_id AS vehicle_id, t.transaction_time AS transaction_time, t.amount AS amount, t.transfer_flag AS transfer_flag FROM ods_card_transaction t WHERE t.city_code = '3301') SELECT p.transaction_id AS transaction_id, p.card_id AS card_id, vc.card_type AS card_type, p.line_id AS line_id, dl.line_name AS line_name, p.vehicle_id AS vehicle_id, p.transaction_time AS transaction_time, p.amount AS amount, p.transfer_flag AS transfer_flag FROM priced p INNER JOIN valid_card vc ON p.card_id = vc.card_id INNER JOIN dim_bus_line dl ON p.line_id = dl.line_id WHERE p.transfer_flag = 0

models.name: dws_line_transfer_summary
models.description: 线路换乘明细层：派生换乘分类列并关联线路公司，筛选常规公交线路
models.sql: SELECT d.line_id AS line_id, d.line_name AS line_name, CASE WHEN d.transfer_flag = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS is_transfer, d.amount AS txn_amount, l.company_id AS company_id FROM dwd_card_transaction_detail d INNER JOIN dim_bus_line l ON d.line_id = l.line_id WHERE l.line_type = 'BUS'

models.name: ads_transfer_settlement
models.description: 换乘结算广告层：CTE 先筛换乘线路与公司维度，再关联明细并在 WHERE 中使用换乘标志
models.sql: WITH line_txn AS (SELECT s.line_id AS line_id, s.line_name AS line_name, s.is_transfer AS is_transfer, s.txn_amount AS txn_amount FROM dws_line_transfer_summary s WHERE s.is_transfer = 'Y'), company_dim AS (SELECT l.line_id AS line_id, l.company_id AS company_id FROM dim_bus_line l) SELECT lt.line_id AS line_id, lt.line_name AS line_name, cd.company_id AS company_id, lt.is_transfer AS is_transfer, lt.txn_amount AS settlement_amount FROM line_txn lt INNER JOIN company_dim cd ON lt.line_id = cd.line_id INNER JOIN dwd_card_transaction_detail d ON lt.line_id = d.line_id WHERE d.transfer_flag = 1

models.name: ads_status_probe_settlement
models.description: 卡状态探针结算层：卡状态只出现在 EXISTS 子查询的返回列，存在性判断只看发卡城市；调整卡状态口径不影响本模型
models.sql: SELECT t.transaction_id AS transaction_id, t.amount AS amount FROM ods_card_transaction t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT ci.status AS status FROM ods_card_info ci WHERE ci.issue_city = '3301')

models.name: ads_active_card_settlement
models.description: 有效卡结算层：卡状态在 EXISTS 子查询内层 WHERE 中参与嵌套筛选，存在有效卡才结算
models.sql: SELECT t.transaction_id AS transaction_id, t.amount AS amount FROM ods_card_transaction t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT ci.card_id AS card_id FROM ods_card_info ci WHERE ci.status = 'ACTIVE')

models.name: ads_city_in_settlement
models.description: 发卡城市集合结算层：主查询单列 IN 子查询，发卡城市是 IN 的返回列，卡状态在 IN 子查询 WHERE 中
models.sql: SELECT t.transaction_id AS transaction_id, t.amount AS amount FROM ods_card_transaction t WHERE t.city_code IN (SELECT ci.issue_city AS issue_city FROM ods_card_info ci WHERE ci.status = 'ACTIVE')

models.name: ads_nested_exists_in_settlement
models.description: 嵌套谓词结算层：EXISTS 内嵌单列 IN，换乘标志在最内层 IN 子查询的 WHERE 中
models.sql: SELECT t.transaction_id AS transaction_id, t.amount AS amount FROM ods_card_transaction t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT ci.card_id AS card_id FROM ods_card_info ci WHERE ci.issue_city IN (SELECT t2.city_code AS city_code FROM ods_card_transaction t2 WHERE t2.transfer_flag = 1))
